item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Pope heads to Cameroon with message of peace for conflict zone
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV left Algeria on Wednesday headed for Cameroon for a four-day trip that includes a visit to the epicentre of a nearly decade-long separatist conflict, where he is due to bring a message of peace. FRANCE 24's Indira Ayuk reports from Yaoundé, Cameroon.

item.title: Pope Leo heads to Cameroon with message of peace as separatists announce 3-day truce
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV will touch down in Cameroon Wednesday for the next stop on his 11-day apostolic journey across Africa. Separatist groups in the English-speaking west declared a three-day ceasefire to allow the pontiff to travel to the conflict-ridden region.
